What is HARG therapy?

HARG (Hair Re-generative therapy) therapy is a regenerative medicine and hair regeneration treatment that has attracted attention in recent years as one of the AGA treatments.
HARG cocktail is injected directly into the scalp to promote hair growth. HARG cocktail is a drug containing more than 150 types of growth factors extracted from adipose stem cells. A major feature is that you only need to visit the hospital for a certain period of time (5 to 6 months), and then only need maintenance once or twice a year.

Effects of HARG therapy

More than 150 types of growth factors contained in HARG cocktail promote regeneration of the scalp and hair roots, increasing hair growth. It also contains ingredients such as vitamins and amino acids, so you can expect it to be effective in hair growth, hair growth, and hair loss prevention.

When can I feel the effects?

Treatment is started once every 3 to 4 weeks, and 6 treatments can be completed after 5 to 6 months. After that, the effect will last with maintenance once or twice a year.
In most cases, you will begin to see results within the treatment period of 5 to 6 months. You may notice a difference in as early as 3 months.

Advantages and disadvantages of HARG therapy

Benefits

Effective for thinning hair, hair regeneration, and hair growth

We provide fundamental regenerative treatment through a multifaceted approach that improves thinning hair, regenerates hair, and stimulates hair growth.

It can be expected to be effective for women who have not been able to receive conventional treatment.

Conventional treatments for men may not be suitable for women, but HARG therapy is a treatment that can be expected to be effective regardless of gender.

No scars left due to the use of ultra-fine needles

Because the HARG cocktail is injected using an ultra-fine needle, there is no possibility of scarring on the scalp like in hair transplant surgery.
Being able to freely arrange your hairstyle without worrying about scars on your scalp is a great benefit for women.

Disadvantages

May be painful

Local anesthesia is administered before the HARG cocktail injection, but the injection may be painful.

It does not have an immediate effect and does not feel effective immediately after injection.

HARG therapy, like other AGA treatments, is not a quick fix. No matter how early, the effects will start to appear after 3 months.

Side effects, risks and downtime

The side effects, risks, and downtime of HARG therapy are as follows. If you have any concerns, please feel free to contact our hospital.

side effects

  • In rare cases, symptoms such as fever, rash, redness, and itching may occur, but they usually subside within 1 to 2 days.

Downtime and precautions

Treatment time: about 20-30 minutes
Downtime: Almost none. *There are individual differences

  • You can wash your hair, shower, and bathe on the day of your treatment, but please wait at least 6 hours after your treatment.
  • However, please refrain from perming or dyeing your hair for one week after treatment.
  • Please refrain from drinking alcohol, smoking, taking long baths, or strenuous exercise immediately after treatment.
  • Please refrain from using hair conditioners for 6 hours after treatment.
  • Please refrain from cutting your hair for 3 days after treatment.

Difference between HARG therapy and hair growth mesotherapy

There is also a method called ``hair growth mesotherapy'' that involves injecting drugs into the scalp. Although it seems to be a similar treatment to HARG therapy, hair growth mesotherapy uses different drugs depending on the clinic. Therefore, each clinic has different effects.
On the other hand, HARG therapy uses a HARG cocktail with a fixed composition of ingredients, so there is no big difference in how the effects appear.
